result.topic_en: Gauss works on counting Gaussian integers x+iy in regions (quadrants/strips) relative to multiplication by a−bi, with lattice-rectangle diagrams, toward biquadratic residue (Gauss lemma–type) counting; sets D, D', A, P, Q, R, S are related.
